title: Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM) Successfully Conducts 2nd Session on Interview Skills and CV Crafting for Final-Semester Students
text:
The University Advancement &
Career Development Center successfully organized its 2
nd
interactive
session titled “Effective CV Crafting & Interview Skills” on April 23,
2026, at the IBL Hall for 8th-semester students from the Faculties of Social
Sciences and Arts & Humanities. The session aimed to enhance students’
professional skills in CV writing and interview preparation.

The session was conducted by Dr.
Junaid Athar Khan, Assistant Professor, IBL, AWKUM, and Dr. Ashraf Zia,
Assistant Professor, Department of Computer Science, AWKUM. The speakers shared
practical insights on effective resume writing, interview techniques,
communication skills, and professional presentation, emphasizing the importance
of aligning academic achievements with industry expectations. Students actively
participated in the session and learned modern strategies for career readiness
and employability.

Dr. Muhammad Bilal, Director
UA&CDC, reiterated the University Advancement & Career Development
Center’s continued commitment to supporting students in their transition from
academia to the professional world.
